messages:
maria: Customer (StellarPay) requested onboarding for sentinel-21b. Key asks: 8-bit quantized variant, latency target <=200ms P50 on 512-token inc, and no more than 3% regression on our critical prompt set. Pilot in ~2 weeks. Anyone available to triage?

sam: I can triage infra + tests. Do we have model artifacts/format (hf, safetensors, custom)?

maria: s3 link: s3://stellarpay/models/sentinel-21b/v1/weights.safetensors and manifest in repo: git@github.com:stellarpay/sentinel-21b.git. License looks permissive. Customer included an eval set (small) and a larger perf corpus.

marta: FYI customer says pilot start date is firm (14 days). They're OK with iterative quality tuning but need an initial canary in Prod-like env.

jordan: I can own quant runs + fidelity checks. Plan: 1) float baseline eval, 2) q8 calibration (GPTQ/PPQ candidate), 3) smoke serve. Need float checkpoints exported as PT and a sample val set. Can we pin sequence length for perf runs (512)?

lee: infra notes: dedicated-rtx8000 pool has 2 nodes free next week. If we need A100, earliest availability Thu. For canary I'd recommend dedicated pool to match customer SLA. Also we need to create a dedicated model-config: 
```
model: sentinel-21b
quant: int8
max_seq: 512
batching: auto
preferred_pool: ded-rtx8000
```
\nquant-bot: Created ticket IN-3381 and scheduled baseline eval job: jobs/IN-3381/baseline-run. CI link: https://ci.internal/redwood/IN-3381

sam: Minimal bringup checklist (first pass):
- download weights + verify checksum
- run float baseline (accuracy + safety checks)
- run q8 build + compare eval metrics (delta <=3%)
- single-node perf run (512 tokens, batch=1..4) measure P50/P95
- KV cache / streaming sanity check
- deploy canary to ded pool + smoke traffic
- handover note for support + cost estimates

jordan: I'll create eval buckets: small_crit_prompts (customer), regen_set, safety_checks. Will start float baseline tonight and post numbers.

maria: Assigning owners: jordan = quant + eval, lee = infra/canary, sam = test harness + perf scripts, marta = customer comms. ETA: initial baseline by +48h.

marta: I'll tell customer we aim to have a canary within 7 business days and full pilot in 14. I'll flag any constraint from their side.

sam: Quick question: any latency budget for embedding calls (if they use rerank)? we should ask.

maria: Good point — ask product: do they need embeddings? I'll ping their eng lead.

lee: Added a short-term capacity hold on ded-rtx8000 for IN-3381. If we need more GPU, we'll fallback to a100-40gb but config changes required.

quant-bot: Reminder: please attach eval artifact links to ticket IN-3381 for traceability.

jordan: Starting float baseline run now. Will post results and a first q8 candidate in this thread. :rocket:
